name: Ashen Requiem

attributes.description:
Its pale crescent gathers the last whispers of the deep.

Soul Draw: 12% chance on a successful normal weapon attack to deal 30% of the normal death attack as extra death damage, up to 12, and heal 30% of that extra HP damage, up to 3 health. Damage absorbed by mana shield does not heal you. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
Legendary weapon cooldowns are shared by your character. Extra damage is based on the original attack before critical bonuses and mitigation; armor, resistance and player damage rules still apply.
